categories.title: Categories, ready to go
categories.subtitle: {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} in {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}, each with a short description so Siri and the watch can match them. Rename, add or remove any later.

income.note: Small lowercase label after a folder name: this folder holds income, not spending.

stepA11y.note: VoiceOver label of the progress dots at the top of the welcome flow.

title.note: The app's name, as the big title of the first screen.

welcome.subtitle: Local-first budgeting. Set up in under a minute.
welcome.localText: Every number stays on the device. No sign-up, no servers.
welcome.quickText: From the watch, Siri, a Shortcut or a photo of the receipt.
welcome.quickTextNoReceipt: From the watch, Siri or a Shortcut.
welcome.icloudText: A copy is saved to your iCloud Drive every day, up to seven times a day.

cloudRestoredBody.note: date is when the backup was made ("22 Sep"); summary is what was imported, already translated.

languageA11y.note: VoiceOver label of the language switch on the first screen; name is the language in its own language ("English").

location.title: Remember where you spend
location.subtitle: Kopiyka can offer the category you used at the same place last time. iOS asks next — either answer is fine, and the app works fully without it.

homeSubtitle.message: Anything gets bought at home, so nothing is suggested within {radius} m of it. Set it now if you are there, or later in Settings.
homeSubtitle.note: radius is a number of metres.

location.pickedText: Log something where you logged something before and that category is waiting on the keypad.
location.openTitle: Only while the app is open
location.openText: Kopiyka never asks for background location and cannot see where you are once it is closed.
location.localText: The place is saved beside the entry in the local database, like every other number here.
location.homeHere: Nothing is suggested within {radius} m of here.
location.homeNone: Nothing is left out until you set it.
location.useInsteadA11y: Use current location as home instead
location.useA11y: Use my current location as home
location.noFixBody: The phone has not got a fix yet. It usually comes within a few seconds of granting access, and works best away from thick walls — try again in a moment, or set home later in Settings.

account.title: Your main account
account.subtitle: What is on it right now becomes the opening balance. More accounts can be added later in Settings.

continueWith.note: amount is formatted, currency is a code ("UAH").

account.restore: I have a backup to restore

balanceIn.note: Followed by the currency code and name: "Balance now in UAH · Ukrainian hryvnia".

theme.title: Pick a look
theme.subtitle: Eight colour themes, each with a light and a dark side that follow the iPhone. The app icon changes to match. You can change it any time in Settings.
